en.title: Studiocanal Boards Pan-Asian Thriller 'kiDnap Game' Starring Kentaro Sakaguchi and Lee Joon-gi
en.summary: A thrilling new survival drama is set to captivate audiences across Asia and beyond. Studiocanal has officially boarded 'kiDnap Game,' a multi-city thriller featuring top talent from Japan and South Korea.
en.body:
Get ready for a high-stakes chase across the continent. **Studiocanal** has announced its involvement in **kiDnap Game**, an ambitious survival thriller series that spans seven major Asian cities: Tokyo, Seoul, Taipei, Singapore, Bangkok, Manila, and Naha.

Directed by Japan's **Yusuke Kato**, known for his work on **Last Friends**, the 11-part series promises a gripping narrative centered on simultaneous kidnappings that strike fear across these diverse urban landscapes. The drama brings together production powerhouses from **Fuji Television** (Japan), **MakerVille** (Hong Kong), and **Simstory** (South Korea), indicating a robust production quality and a truly pan-Asian vision.

The series boasts a stellar cast, led by Japanese star **Kentaro Sakaguchi** as a Tokyo detective and South Korean superstar **Lee Joon-gi** as a retired doctor from Seoul. Their paths will undoubtedly collide as they navigate the terrifying mystery surrounding the disappearances and the chilling emails that follow, posing a single, ominous question to the victims' families.

This collaboration isn't just about combining creative forces; it's a strategic move to capture a massive audience. With a premiere slated for October and distribution already secured across 18 regions worldwide, **kiDnap Game** is positioned to be a significant international event. The series aims to deliver a potent mix of action, crime, mystery, and psychological tension, appealing directly to fans who crave complex, character-driven thrillers.

## A Global Cat-and-Mouse Game

The premise of **kiDnap Game** immediately sets up a compelling conflict with global implications. The simultaneous nature of the kidnappings across seven distinct cities suggests a meticulously planned operation, raising the stakes for both the characters and the audience. Viewers can expect a narrative that weaves through different cultures and environments, offering a unique visual and thematic tapestry. The involvement of **Studiocanal** in bringing this project to buyers at Mipcom signifies strong international confidence in its potential, suggesting a broad appeal that transcends regional boundaries.

## What Fans Can Expect

For fans of **Kentaro Sakaguchi** and **Lee Joon-gi**, this series represents a chance to see their favorite actors in a high-octane, suspenseful drama. The combination of their talents, coupled with **Yusuke Kato**'s directorial vision, hints at a performance-driven experience. The series is being touted as a landmark project for its ambitious scope and its fusion of Japanese, Korean, and Hong Kong production expertise. The blend of survival elements with a complex crime mystery is sure to resonate with binge-watchers looking for their next obsession, promising a tightly plotted, emotionally charged journey across the heart of Asia.

## What's Next

**kiDnap Game** is set to premiere this October. Further details regarding specific streaming platforms or broadcast schedules in different regions are expected to be announced soon, with **Studiocanal** actively presenting the series to international buyers at Mipcom.
